locator: I q.75 a.2 co., Nihil autem potest per se operari, with ad 1–2
interpretation: For every principle, an intellectual exercise attributed to it without bodily participation requires exclusion of inherence as accident or material form. This operation/existence correspondence is an open source principle. Read within q.76 a.1: the human being understands through the soul as its form; operation attribution does not identify the soul with the complete human being.
